chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Bint Ilyas from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no return (of the wife) to the husband, nor (of the husband) to the wife."

key_terms.الرَّدُّ: Return (of the wife to the husband in revocable divorce)

ai.seo_question: What does the concept of 'rad' (return) mean in Shia Islamic divorce law?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the mechanics of *Talaq al-Munassakha* (divorce by agreement), where the wife returns the dowry or compensation to regain her freedom, thereby precluding the standard 'return' (*Radd*) mechanism of the *Iddah* period. This ruling highlights the distinct Shia jurisprudential view that such a transactional dissolution creates a finality that differs from the revocable (*Raj'i*) divorce, emphasizing the wife's agency in securing her release through financial settlement.
